description: Search and filter the local hardware catalog to discover compatible rackmount devices, modular carriers, and sub-modules before mounting. All supplied filters combine with logical AND: 'form_factor' and its alias 'mount_type' accept width shorthands '10inch', '19inch', and '6inch' that match both direct rackmount gear and modular carriers, 'accepted_slot_type' matches both carrier bays and compatible sub-modules, and 'max_depth_mm' bounds chassis depth excluding plug clearance. Returns all matches from the bounded catalog in one unpaginated response sorted in deterministic registration order, with built-in blueprints followed by custom blueprints. Call with no arguments to list the full catalog; use get_device_blueprint to inspect expanded port coordinates for a known slug, or define_custom_blueprint to register unlisted hardware.

accepted_slot_type.description: Sub-module slot compatibility token matching either a sub-module slot_compatibility or a carrier slot accepted_slot_type (e.g., "mini-pc-1liter", "sbc-rpi5", "standard-keystone").

form_factor.description: Primary rack width or mounting form-factor filter (shorthands "10inch", "19inch", and "6inch" match both direct rackmount equipment and modular carriers of that width).

max_depth_mm.description: Maximum allowed chassis depth in millimeters (inclusive upper bound).

min_poe_budget_watts.description: Minimum required PSE PoE output power budget in watts (inclusive lower bound).

mount_type.description: Optional alias for form_factor to filter by physical mounting style ("rackmount-10", "rackmount-19", "rackmount-6", "sub-module", or "shelf-standing"); combined with logical AND if both are provided.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter matching slug, manufacturer, or model name (omit to match all).

name: search_catalog

items.description: Compact hardware blueprint summary returned by search_catalog.

category.description: Primary functional category of the hardware unit.

electrical_role.description: Role in the electrical and PoE Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG).

max_system_watts.description: Peak system power consumption in watts.

mount_type.description: Physical form factor and mounting mechanism.

poe_budget_watts.description: Available PSE PoE output budget in watts (0 if non-PSE).

port_count.description: Total number of expanded physical ports.

slot_compatibility.description: Sub-module slot compatibility token, or null for rackmount equipment.

slots.description: Available carrier bays when mount_type is "modular-carrier".

max_dimensions_mm.description: Maximum internal bounding dimensions of a carrier slot in mm.

depth.description: Maximum allowed child depth in mm.

height.description: Maximum allowed child height in mm.

width.description: Maximum allowed child width in mm.

slug.description: Unique lowercase kebab-case hardware blueprint slug.

count.description: Total number of catalog blueprints matching all supplied filter criteria.

issues.description: Structured diagnostic findings (ERROR, WARNING, INFO) with actionable remediation_suggestions.

items.description: Single validation finding with deterministic self-correction feedback.

affected_instances.description: Device instance IDs involved in this diagnostic issue.

message.description: Detailed engineering explanation with exact millimeter/watt figures.

items.description: Structured self-correction action for autonomous agent remediation.

description.description: Human- and agent-readable explanation of the remediation step.

suggested_cable_type.description: Suggested replacement cable_type (e.g. angled plug or higher speed grade).

suggested_face.description: Mounting or port face relative to the rack or chassis.

suggested_u_positions.description: Candidate 1-indexed U positions that resolve the spatial conflict.

target_cable_id.description: Cable connection cable_id targeted by this remediation action.

target_instance_id.description: Device instance_id targeted by this remediation action.

remediation_suggestions.description: Actionable self-correction instructions for the calling LLM agent.

severity.description: Severity level of the engineering constraint diagnostic.

stage.description: Validation pipeline stage (1..5) that produced this finding.

u_range.description: Inclusive [start_u, end_u] range where the issue occurs.

status.description: Deterministic execution outcome: "VALID" when the operation succeeded with 0 validation errors; "INVALID" when precondition or engineering validation errors are present in issues[].

summary.description: Concise human- and agent-readable summary of the tool result and validation status.
